\caption{Matched-budget replay on the development pools (MedQA 200, MMLU-Pro 200, GPQA 100, AQuA-RAT 254). For each policy, the questions on which it made its first advisor call are rescored with the forced-call result of that advisor on the same question, and the other questions are scored with the direct answer; this gives the replay accuracy (\%). Calls (E/R/V): the number of first calls the policy made to the Extractor, Reasoner and Verifier. The same number of calls per advisor is then reassigned to uniformly random questions 2,000 times; Random 95\% is the 2.5--97.5 percentile interval of the resulting accuracies, $p$ the fraction of the 2,000 random assignments whose accuracy is at least the policy's replay accuracy, and Above whether the replay accuracy exceeds the upper end of the interval. Bold: replay accuracy above the interval. R3/R5: round 3 or 5 of the chain; no GRPO: the v3 chain trained with SFT only; +GRPO: the main v3+GRPO chain. $\dagger$: taken from the results page because the per-question files of these runs were not archived, so their per-advisor call counts are unavailable (--), and for the AQuA-RAT round-5 policies only $p$ and the above/below outcome were recorded.}
